title: What's New: Enhanced Financial Reporting (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Introduction and overview of financial reporting enhancements
Tile view and navigation for all users
Features for report authors: categories, lifecycle status, and company defaults
Dimension perspectives for running multi-value reports
Audit log for administrators and analysis mode
General Business Central resources for partners

features.name: Tile view for financial reports
features.description: A new tile-based visualization for financial reports replacing the traditional list view, showing category, name, code, status, last run time, and description for each report.
caveats: Data fields are blank if no data is present
Description field appears blank if not entered

features.name: Report categories
features.description: Ability to categorize financial reports into predefined or custom categories for better navigation. Includes 10 default categories like assets, liabilities, and profitability analysis, with option to create custom categories.

features.name: Life cycle status for report definitions
features.description: A status system for report definitions, row definitions, and column definitions with states: active, draft, and retired. Blocked states prevent usage of report definitions in certain states.
caveats: Draft and retired states are considered blocked and prevent report usage

features.name: Company-specific default properties
features.description: Ability to set default values in General Ledger Setup for four report properties: view by, negative number format, company logo position, and status. These defaults inherit to all report definitions that use the default setting.
caveats: Individual reports can override inherited defaults

features.name: Dimension perspectives
features.description: Feature to define dimension perspectives once and reuse them across reports. Supports simple perspectives that run a report for each value in a dimension, custom perspectives selecting specific dimension values, and cross-dimensional perspectives combining values from multiple dimensions.
caveats: Perspective overrides available at runtime on request page

features.name: Report scheduling
features.description: Ability to create and schedule automated report generation with configurable frequency, export formats (Excel and PDF), distribution to inboxes and email, custom filters, and recipient groups.
caveats: Schedule logs available to view execution history

features.name: Report recurrence formula
features.description: Users can set weekly recurrence formulas for scheduled report delivery and specify recipients who should receive the scheduled reports.

features.name: Custom filters for scheduled reports
features.description: Report schedules can include custom filters to control request page values, allowing different schedule configurations with different filter values for the same report.

features.name: Schedule logs for reports
features.description: Users can view schedule logs showing which reports were run, when they were run, and can navigate to report inbox or sent emails for further information on delivered artifacts.

features.name: Audit log for financial reporting
features.description: New audit log feature for administrators and controllers to track report usage, showing who ran reports, when, which format was used, and which reports were executed. Includes predefined and custom filters for different time ranges.
caveats: Filters available for last 30 days, year to date, and custom ranges

features.name: Analysis mode for audit logs
features.description: Audit logs can be taken into analysis mode to create custom reports on financial reporting usage, showing who ran what and when.
